summary_en: Hulic launched a tender offer for all shares of Riso Education Group (TSE Prime: 4714) at 295 yen per share to achieve complete subsidiary status. The offer runs from October 14 to November 26, 2026 (30 business days), with a minimum purchase target of 26,646,601 shares. Hulic currently owns 86,885,599 shares (50.87% stake) and the target company's board recommended shareholders accept the offer.
title_en: Notice Regarding Initiation of Tender Offer for Share Certificates and Other Securities of Riso Education Group Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 4714)
translation_en_brief:
Hulic Co., Ltd. announced on October 13, 2026, that its board of directors has decided to acquire all outstanding shares of Riso Education Group Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime: 4714) through a tender offer to achieve complete subsidiary status. Hulic currently owns 86,885,599 shares representing 50.87% of voting rights. The tender offer is priced at 295 yen per common share and runs for 30 business days from October 14 through November 26, 2026. The minimum purchase target is 26,646,601 shares, which represents approximately 15.6% of outstanding shares (calculated as 26,646,601 divided by 170,815,350 shares, the denominator excluding treasury shares and accounting for warrant dilution). This minimum purchase would bring Hulic's aggregate ownership to 66.56% based on voting rights calculated as of August 31, 2026.

The tender offer also covers six series of stock option warrants (stock-based compensation type) issued between 2018 and 2023, with individual purchase prices ranging from 2,940 to 8,820 yen per warrant depending on the series and exercise terms.

Riso Education Group's board of directors has expressed its support for the tender offer and recommended that shareholders and warrant holders accept the offer. The company operates in the education sector and is currently a consolidated subsidiary of Hulic.
